The University of Pécs, Hungary's oldest university (founded 1367), is one of the biggest Stipendium Hungaricum host institutions, with scholarship places across medicine, health sciences, engineering, business, humanities and arts. The Hungarian Government's Stipendium Hungaricum programme covers full tuition, a monthly stipend, dormitory or housing support and medical insurance.

Programme Highlights

  • Full tuition exemption for the whole duration of the programme
  • Monthly stipend: HUF 43,700 (~€110) for bachelor's/master's; HUF 140,000 (~€350) for doctoral students in the first phase, HUF 180,000 in the second
  • Free dormitory place or a housing contribution, plus comprehensive medical insurance
  • Apply through the national system (apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu) and select the University of Pécs

Who Should Apply

Citizens of Stipendium Hungaricum partner countries (check the current list on the official site) applying for a full-degree bachelor's, master's, one-tier (e.g. medical) or doctoral programme at the University of Pécs. You apply through your home country's nominating partner and select Pécs in the online system.

Funding and Costs

The scholarship is one of Europe's most generous 'tuition-free plus stipend' packages: tuition is exempted entirely, and living support scales with level — doctoral candidates receive the highest stipend. Hungary's cost of living keeps the monthly amount practical (Pécs is one of the country's cheapest student cities).

Deadline and How to Apply

Register on apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu, choose the University of Pécs and your programme, upload the required documents (diplomas, transcript, passport, medical certificate, motivation letter) and complete any programme-specific exams or interviews. Your sending partner then nominates you before the final selection round. Key deadline information: 15 January 2027, 2:00 PM CET.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About University of Pécs

Founded in 1367, the University of Pécs is Hungary's oldest university and one of the largest Stipendium Hungaricum host universities, enrolling several thousand scholarship students across medical, health, business, engineering, humanities and arts programmes.

Official website: https://international.pte.hu

Contact

Questions about this scholarship, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official scholarship page (see the Official Link section above). Always include your applicant ID or programme name so the admissions or scholarship team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements and deadlines on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form — transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
  • Deadlines shown in local time (CET/CEST) as published by the provider; convert to your own time zone before planning.
